name: Special Workspaces
description: A hidden group of real regular workspaces reserved above a configurable threshold (slot 1 = threshold+1, slot 2 = threshold+2, ...), toggled with a single configurable keybind. Since they're genuine regular workspaces, SUPER+Z/X, scroll, swipe, and clicking the bar all navigate them natively -- no Hyprland special-workspace feature, no custom scripts. Pairs with positive.workspace-app-indicator for the focused-app badge.
author: POSiTiiiV
permissions: Reads this mod's own settings (threshold/dynamicMode/slotCount) to render and navigate the hidden workspace block
Renders hidden-group slots on the workspace bar using the same numbering/occupancy display as regular workspaces, plus a dimmed highlight marker
Runs 'hyprctl reload' when this mod's keybind/threshold/slot-count/animation settings change
